title: Artificial intelligence-based computer-aided diagnosis system supports diagnosis of lymph node metastasis in esophageal squamous cell carcinoma: A multicenter study
summary: AI assistance increased expert accuracy 0.712→0.833 and specificity 0.697→0.891 for nodal metastasis diagnosis. Multicenter retrospective evaluation with two external hospital cohorts; no prospective outcome or treatment-benefit validation.
ai_technology: U-Net-based lesion segmentation and PET metabolic features support AI-assisted expert diagnosis of lymph-node metastasis
